To file a Level 1 standard appeal, you must submit your request in writing or call the plan within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice of the coverage decision. (Evidence of Coverage 2026, plan H5141-004, Chapter: If you have a problem or complaint > How to make a Level 1 appeal)
For a Level 1 fast appeal, you or your doctor must contact the plan and explain why your health requires a fast appeal. You can make this request in writing or by calling the plan. (Evidence of Coverage 2026, plan H5141-004, Chapter: If you have a problem or complaint > How to make a Level 1 appeal)
If you are requesting a Level 2 appeal, you must contact the independent review organization within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice of the Level 1 decision. (Evidence of Coverage 2026, plan H5141-004, Chapter: If you have a problem or complaint > How to make a Level 2 appeal)
For a Level 2 fast appeal, you must ask the independent review organization for a fast appeal, and they must respond within 72 hours if they agree to expedite the process. (Evidence of Coverage 2026, plan H5141-004, Chapter: If you have a problem or complaint > How to make a Level 2 appeal)
